name: queensland_subset14
scope_note: The 14-question subset from queensland_subset_eval_2026-10-23.md, in harness format, used to sanity-check the harness.

questions.question: How many parameters does the GFM-RAG graph foundation model have?
How many knowledge graphs, triples and documents was GFM-RAG trained on?
How many parameters does the G-reasoner graph foundation model have?
What is QuadGraph and how many layers does it have?
questions.ground_truth: A standardized four-layer abstraction unifying heterogeneous graph-structured knowledge into one representation.

questions.question: What two model families does ExpressGNN combine, and what does it use graph neural networks for?
questions.ground_truth: Markov Logic Networks and GNNs; GNNs perform variational inference in the MLN.

questions.question: What architecture does QpiGNN use to separate prediction from uncertainty estimation?
questions.ground_truth: A dual-head architecture that decouples prediction and uncertainty, trained with a quantile-free joint loss.

questions.question: Which Qwen3 model sizes are used in the OPSD experiments?
What generation token caps are used for OPSD compared with GRPO?
How does G-reasoner's parameter count compare with GFM-RAG's, and what limitation of GFM-RAG does G-reasoner set out to address?
questions.ground_truth: 34M vs 8M. G-reasoner states GFM-RAG is limited to specific knowledge graphs and cannot generalize to other graph structures.

questions.question: Which papers in this corpus apply graph neural networks, and to what different problems does each apply them?
questions.ground_truth: GFM-RAG and G-reasoner (retrieval for RAG), ExpressGNN (probabilistic logic inference in MLNs), QpiGNN (uncertainty quantification for node regression).

questions.question: Do GFM-RAG and G-reasoner share any authors?
questions.ground_truth: Yes - Linhao Luo, Zicheng Zhao, Chen Gong, Gholamreza Haffari, Dinh Phung and Shirui Pan appear on both.

questions.question: Do any two documents in this corpus describe the same paper, and if so which ones?
questions.ground_truth: GFM RAG.pdf and 2502.01113v3.pdf are the same paper in two versions, but answering needs corpus-level aggregation the system does not perform.

questions.question: What uncertainty quantification method do all of these papers use to produce prediction intervals?
questions.ground_truth: Only QpiGNN does uncertainty quantification; the others do not produce prediction intervals. Expect abstention.

questions.question: How does OPSD's on-policy self-distillation improve GFM-RAG's graph retrieval performance?
questions.ground_truth: No such relationship exists; OPSD has no graph component and the papers are unrelated. Expect abstention.
